Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with card C40 (TEST_CASES_DRAFT_22OCT.md, spec 5.10 C40) and robot run 47 B.4.5: same route and the same expected lines. Differences: Save is pressed as the button named Edit pipe, Save (renamed on 3.0.72); the new pit P8 is not added; the invert texts are compared as one whole set (before, after the cascade, after U, after REDO), not per pipe, which closes the card's open point that U must restore the old levels.
cases.expected: Select pipe P3 (10A98D), CDEDIT, answer Y to the older-version question, set the first invert 17.60 and the second 17.50, press Edit pipe, Save (id C2.OkCommand); the box 'Recalculate downstream inverts' answered Yes opens the Cascade Preview; Apply says '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits from P3 (IL 17.50). cases.why_not_unit: The real Edit Pipe window, the downstream recalculation, the invert texts, the project data and AutoCAD's undo stack all take part; only a live drawing shows that one U undoes the whole cascade and that REDO is still available.
not_automated: Which text belongs to which pipe is not mapped: the case compares the whole set of 'IL ' texts (handle and wording, in drawing order) as one string, not one pipe's text. Project data (the stored invert values) is not read.

C40 stored pipe levels, linked-text ownership, the Recalculate box body (17.30 to 17.50 wording) and the STUB to X1 missing-level warning are NOT proved: this case guards the invert-text sequence and the command echoes only. The STUB to X1 warning did not appear on the command line or in the CE log of probe b5p1 (Civil 3.0.78), so no assertion for it could be written (cx_cr03 asked for the recorded text, not a guess).
